query: WITH batch AS (SELECT source_page, page_kind FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 489 AND 493), counts AS (SELECT 'source_pages'::text AS entity, COUNT(*)::bigint AS count FROM batch UNION ALL SELECT 'facts', COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 489 AND 493 UNION ALL SELECT 'notes', COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 489 AND 493 UNION ALL SELECT 'mcqs', COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 489 AND 493 UNION ALL SELECT 'mcq_options', COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id = o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 489 AND 493 UNION ALL SELECT 'flashcards', COUNT(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0489-0493:%' UNION ALL SELECT 'search_documents', COUNT(*) FROM public.search_documents d WHERE (d.entity_type = 'fact' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_facts f WHERE f.id = d.entity_id AND f.source_page BETWEEN 489 AND 493)) OR (d.entity_type = 'note' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_notes n WHERE n.id = d.entity_id AND n.source_page BETWEEN 489 AND 493)) OR (d.entity_type = 'mcq' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_mcqs m WHERE m.id = d.entity_id AND m.source_page BETWEEN 489 AND 493)) UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_verifications', COUNT(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 489 AND 493) SELECT entity, count FROM counts ORDER BY entity ASC LIMIT 20;
